label: Dictionary matching
subgoals: Predict each candidate's failing patterns by simulation or dictionary
Count the patterns where prediction and observation disagree
Choose the candidate with the fewest mismatches

label: Effect-cause analysis
subgoals: Find the fan-in cone of each failing output
Intersect the cones under the single-fault assumption
Keep passing outputs out of the subtraction

label: Yield learning
subgoals: Attribute diagnosed candidates to layers and mechanisms with layout
Rank mechanisms by their contribution to expected defects
Recompute the Poisson yield without the top mechanism
